title: Why hasn't my group member paid yet?
summary: This document explains timing-related reasons a group split member hasn’t paid: the payment may still be within the allowed 16-day window, or they may not yet receive the most recent automatic reminder if the 4-day cadence hasn’t elapsed. It also lists checks (member on split, correct contact details, reminder timeline at 4 intervals, creation timestamp within the 16 period) and next steps (manual reminder, close/recreate split if more time is requested, add notes to the split description for shared context).
faqs: Why hasn’t my group member paid yet—could it be because it’s still within the 16-day window?
If the reminders are automatic, could they not have received the latest one yet because the 4-day interval hasn’t elapsed?
What can I check to confirm the member is set up correctly in the split (name in split, contact details)?

How far into the 16-day period am I, and where can I check that using the split’s creation timestamp?
What should I do next if they still don’t pay—send a manual reminder or close/recreate the split with expectations aligned to the 4 cycle?
